findings: Body tests/tui/agent_attention.rs:222-251 asserts the refreshed title/Unread header, the SetView target and a MarkReviewed whose expected equals the pre-refresh ReadyObservation; review_on_reply builds that request from unread.reply_target (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/state.rs:4777-4790). Consolidate not confirmed: the body's post-release restoration at tests/tui/agent_search.rs:145-161 (no row contains [1] and the original row from column five is restored) is absent from both named tests. tests/tui/session_jump_single_digit.rs:338-349 asserts only the absence of "[01]", which is vacuous for single-digit labels; label hiding is covered by a different neighbour, tests/tui/agent_search.rs:337-346. Geometry, per-row labels and row count are genuinely duplicated by tests/tui/session_jump_single_digit.rs:191-254. Resolved to keep with U=2 and corrected reasons.

final_review.behavior: While Control is held the first nine visible running Agent rows get [1]..[9] badges without changing the status/title columns or the row count, and releasing Control restores the unlabelled rows.
final_review.failure_caught: A badge inserted before the glyph shifting every title column, an extra row per label, or the focused agent left unlabelled so Ctrl+1 does not exist.
final_review.criticality_reason: A mislabeled or shifted row makes the user pick a different agent than the badge shows; the hold can be released harmlessly, so it is bounded (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/render.rs:1300-1330).
final_review.signal_reason: Compares each labelled row's text after five cells with the pre-hold row, asserts the row count is unchanged, checks labels [1]/[2]/[3], and checks the unlabelled restore (tests/tui/agent_search.rs:92-162).
final_review.uniqueness_reason: The skip(5) geometry, row count and per-row labels are covered by tests/tui/session_jump_single_digit.rs:191-254, and label hiding after a full release by tests/tui/agent_search.rs:337-346. The named tests/tui/session_jump_single_digit.rs:338-349 release case only asserts the absence of "[01]", which is vacuous for single-digit labels, so the restore assertion at tests/tui/agent_search.rs:150-161 is not covered by the named retained tests.
final_review.fidelity_reason: Real sidebar renderer and the real modifier-event path on a TestBackend; the badge placement is the subject (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/render.rs:1300-1330).
final_review.recommendation_reason: Partial redundancy only: the two named session_jump_single_digit tests cover badge geometry/labels but not release restoration, and the cited release test cannot observe a lingering [1]. Keep the row instead of consolidating on the stated evidence.
final_review.cost_drivers: Three 120x40 renders per phase and two modifier events

findings: Body tests/tui/agent_search.rs:574-587 checks the Browse footer, the Space-v popup and the palette text; the binding lives at crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/keymap.rs:440-470. A discoverability-only claim with C1/S2/U3 is accurate.

Body tests/tui/agent_search.rs:616-655 asserts per-row label presence/absence after an insertion and a run replacement, unchanged focus on the refused digit, the 'Agent unavailable' footer and a successful retry; availability comes from target.still_matches (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/state.rs:1096-1112). S4 is supported by four independent outcomes.

Single-digit labels and the footer are duplicated by tests/tui/session_jump_single_digit.rs:57-104 (per-id labels, [01] and [10] negatives, footer) and 191-254. The named retained tests never press and release Control before opening the Agents palette, so tests/tui/agent_search.rs:698-704 remains unique. Resolved to keep with U=2.

final_review.behavior: Sixteen visible agents get only single-digit badges 1-9 (no [01]/[10]), the footer advertises Ctrl+1–9 while held, and the Agents search still opens after release.
final_review.failure_caught: Two-digit or tenth labels, or a footer advertising a digit range that does not exist.
final_review.criticality_reason: A wrong range makes the user press a digit that selects nothing or the wrong agent; bounded (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/state.rs:1064-1082).
final_review.signal_reason: Asserts [1] and [9] present, [01] and [10] absent across rows, the footer text, then a real 's' open (tests/tui/agent_search.rs:659-705).
final_review.uniqueness_reason: tests/tui/session_jump_single_digit.rs:57-104 asserts the single-digit rule, footer and per-id labels across counts 0/1/9/10/50, and tests/tui/session_jump_single_digit.rs:191-254 covers the ninth cutoff. Neither presses and releases Control before opening Agents search, which is the assertion at tests/tui/agent_search.rs:698-704.
final_review.fidelity_reason: Real render, footer and picker entry; the badge count rule is the subject (crates/ovrcr-tui/src/dashboard/state.rs:1064-1100).
final_review.recommendation_reason: Most of the single-digit contract is duplicated, but post-release availability of the Agents palette (tests/tui/agent_search.rs:698-704) is not exercised by the named retained tests. Keep rather than consolidate.
final_review.cost_drivers: Two full 120x40 renders and a release event
